info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Appeals-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Appeal Retrieval API enables users to access and review detailed information about insurance claims that have been appealed. This API focuses on providing insights into the status and outcomes of claims appeals, which can assist insurance professionals, claim adjusters, and customer service representatives in making informed decisions. Typical use cases include monitoring ongoing claims, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring efficient handling of appeals. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can streamline their workflow and enhance customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve details related to a specific claim appeal, providing necessary information for review and action.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving claims appeal information. This body must conform to the specified JSON schema to ensure valid requests and responses.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the appeal data is returned.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsAppealsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to claims and appeals. It is a placeholder that indicates the request should contain a string.

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the appeal.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the appeal process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the request.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsAppealsResponse.description: Response schema for the appeals operation GET request.

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the audit entry was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details of the audit information related to the appeal.

schema.description: Indicates the time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request.
